slice: Natural conversation round 22: emotional states not mistaken for introductions

before.give me a pep talk, i'm nervous: Nervous — nice to put a name to you. I'll remember that.

after.give me a pep talk, i'm nervous: Hey. I'm here. Take a breath — in, and out. You've gotten through things before. You've got this.

mechanism: expanded the state-word blocklist (nervous, worried, frustrated, calm, proud, etc.) so 'i'm <state>' is never read as a self-introduction, while real names still are
